items: ✓ make a prediction you are sure about — fares will go up, cities won’t get quieter
✓ make a prediction you are not sure about — cars might disappear, it might not open
✓ soften a prediction — I think… will , will probably , probably won’t
✓ ask about the future — Will fares go up? — and answer Yes, they will / No, they won’t
✓ talk about transport — fare, bus pass, cycle lane, traffic jam, pollution, reliable, convenient
✓ choose between finished and unfinished time recycled — Paris has built… against Shenzhen replaced… in 2017
